script_text:
This is the Food Line briefing for June 11, 2026.

Today's briefing is based on 2 current public signals selected from 30 reviewed records.

St. Francis House had empty shelves in May. The June USDA delivery was smaller than May's, and the pantry is down 64% compared with January. Summer school-meal gaps and SNAP/USDA pressure are adding strain in Roanoke, VA.

In Roanoke, VA, Cuts to SNAP and other USDA programs are leaving more families with fewer options.

The Roanoke, VA signal points to pantry demand and supply strain.

In Tucson, AZ, KOLD / 13 News reported that Catholic Community Services' Tucson food bank saw rising demand from first-time visitors. Supplies were running out more regularly, and some visitors could not get food because lines were too long or supplies were nearly gone.

Source links, excerpts, and background references are available in the public source table.

This has been the Food Line briefing from The Blue Fern Co.
episode_summary: Today's Food Line briefing tracks food-bank demand in Roanoke, VA. In Roanoke, VA, Cuts to SNAP and other USDA programs are leaving more families with fewer options. Background and source links are available in the public source table.
